source.title: Mikola - Warbeat Compere
source.name: Mikola
source.description: A lively Support capable of conjuring an arena at the heart of the battlefield, rewarding allies upon its capture.

skills.name: Dauntless Hymn

description.raw: Mikola generates a 2-tile Courage Sphere that follows her around, increasing Haste by 40 and Ranged DEF by 10 for all allies within range, while increasing her own Haste by 30 and Ranged DEF by 10. When Mikola deals total damage equal to 300% of her initial ATK while Courage Sphere is around, a Healing Wave will emerge, restoring 80% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) HP to all allies within range. Courage Sphere lasts for 10s.

text: Increases the healing amount of Healing Wave to 90% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Increases the duration of Courage Sphere to 12s.
Increases the healing amount of Healing Wave to 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Increases the healing amount of Healing Wave to 110% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Mikola generates a Courage Sphere and provides buffs for nearby allies. Upon dealing sufficient damage, she heals all allies within range.

skills.name: Heroic Duel

description.raw: Mikola generates an Honor Arena spanning the battlefield when a battle starts, lasting until the battle ends. The side with more units within the arena will gain control of it after maintaining the advantage for 3s. Mikola restores all allies' HP by 12% (ATK-based) + 2% (SP-based) per second and increases their ATK by 14% + 1% (SP-based) when her side gains control of the Honor Arena.

skills.name: Vigorous Call

description.raw: Mikola rings her bell, restoring 130% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) HP and increasing Phys and Magic DEF by 40% for herself and the 2 weakest allies for 5s.
active: Mikola rings her bell, restoring 130% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) HP and increasing Phys and Magic DEF by 40% for herself and the 2 weakest allies for 5s.

skills.name: Passionate Opening

description.raw: Mikola enhances her Courage Sphere after it has been active for 6s, granting Combat Fury to all allied heroes (except herself) within range, and dealing damage equal to 50% of her ATK per second to enemies adjacent to these allies. The enhancements reset when the Courage Sphere disappears.
